description: This is a unit test class for the FeatureModified class in the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.things package. It contains test methods to verify immutability, equality/hashcode, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception cases related to FeatureModified objects.

classes.name: FeatureModifiedTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for FeatureModified, testing immutability, equality, JSON serialization/deserialization, and exception cases.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the FeatureModified class is immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Checks the correctness of hashCode and equals methods of FeatureModified class.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Ensures constructing FeatureModified with a null ThingId string throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Ensures constructing FeatureModified with a null ThingId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullFeature
methods.description: Ensures constructing FeatureModified with a null feature throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that the JSON output of FeatureModified matches the expected JSON.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests creating a FeatureModified instance from valid JSON input.

methods.name: createInstanceFromJsonWithNullFeature
methods.description: Tests creating a FeatureModified from JSON where the feature is null.

methods.name: getResourcePathReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that getResourcePath returns the correct JSON pointer based on the feature ID.
